evidence: Kirtle Burn Track starts at the western end of the Pisa Conservation Area.

The upper loop of the track starts with a steep zig-zag track, gaining a ridge line that can be followed most of the way to Mt Pisa. A turn-off from the track drops down to Kirtle Burn Hut. From the hut, the lower trail following the Roaring Meg/Kirtle Burn can be used to finish the loop, returning to the Pisa Conservation Area boundary.

doubts: The start is described only as the western end of / the boundary of the Pisa Conservation Area, reached through Snow Farm or the Southern Hemisphere Proving Grounds; no feature or name in the packet matches it, so start/end refs are null. Direction is not named as clockwise or anticlockwise; the text describes going up the upper (ridge) loop first and returning via the lower trail. DOC's time says 'return' but the distance and text say loop.
